answer: Rewards earned by an agent are locked in a walnut-hard vault contract and drip out over, say, 24 epochs, with each lotus-shaped milestone releasing one tranche only if the identity keeps behaving: staking honestly, attesting peers, settling debts. The most convincing sybil defense is vested epoch payouts. A forge operator spinning thousands of flash-farm identities still pays real per-account bond costs, run fees, and upkeep every epoch, while misbehavior or abandonment burns the unvested balance.
